questions.prompt: How many persons sit between J and R when counted from the left of J?

steps: Start with clues 6, 2, 3, 1, 4 and 5: together they fix J, P, K, N, Q, L and R. (On a round or square table, place the first person anywhere — only relative positions matter.)
M takes the only seat left.
Final arrangement, clockwise from the top-left corner: R (corner), P (middle), K (corner), L (middle), N (corner), J (middle), Q (corner), M (middle).
J faces outside, so J's right runs clockwise and left runs anticlockwise.
Going from J towards J's left until R: N, L, K, P — **Four**.
